From 123e495ecc25d32cf3e7958f794013236abdf0d4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2021 21:19:55 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: linkwatch: be more careful about
 dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker

Apparently a concurrent linkwatch_add_event() could
run while we are in __linkwatch_run_queue().

We need to free dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker tracker
under lweventlist_lock protection to avoid this race.

diff --git a/net/core/link_watch.c b/net/core/link_watch.c
index d7d089963b1d..b0f5344d1185 100644
--- a/net/core/link_watch.c
+++ b/net/core/link_watch.c
@@ -166,7 +166,10 @@ static void linkwatch_do_dev(struct net_device *dev)
 
 		netdev_state_change(dev);
 	}
-	dev_put_track(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
+	/* Note: our callers are responsible for
+	 * calling netdev_tracker_free().
+	 */
+	dev_put(dev);
 }
 
 static void __linkwatch_run_queue(int urgent_only)
@@ -209,6 +212,10 @@ static void __linkwatch_run_queue(int urgent_only)
 			list_add_tail(&dev->link_watch_list, &lweventlist);
 			continue;
 		}
+		/* We must free netdev tracker under
+		 * the spinlock protection.
+		 */
+		netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
 		spin_unlock_irq(&lweventlist_lock);
 		linkwatch_do_dev(dev);
 		do_dev--;
@@ -232,6 +239,10 @@ void linkwatch_forget_dev(struct net_device *dev)
 	if (!list_empty(&dev->link_watch_list)) {
 		list_del_init(&dev->link_watch_list);
 		clean = 1;
+		/* We must release netdev tracker under
+		 * the spinlock protection.
+		 */
+		netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);
 	}
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&lweventlist_lock, flags);
 	if (clean)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `net/core/link_watch.c`**
1. In the function `linkwatch_do_dev`, the line `dev_put_track(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);` has been replaced by a comment and a new line that calls `dev_put(dev);`. This indicates that the responsibility of freeing the `linkwatch_dev_tracker` is handed over to the callers of this function.
  
2. In the function `__linkwatch_run_queue`, before calling `linkwatch_do_dev(dev);`, a new line has been added that invokes `netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);` and includes a comment explaining the necessity to free the tracker under spinlock protection.

3. In the function `linkwatch_forget_dev`, before releasing the device from the `link_watch_list`, a call to `netdev_tracker_free(dev, &dev->linkwatch_dev_tracker);` was added, along with a corresponding comment emphasizing the need to perform this action under spinlock protection.

### Relationship Between Modifications
The modifications establish a synchronized approach to managing memory for the `linkwatch_dev_tracker`. The changes in `linkwatch_do_dev` remove the direct management of freeing the tracker from within that function, shifting the responsibility to other functions. This is crucial since the modifications in both `__linkwatch_run_queue` and `linkwatch_forget_dev` ensure that the tracker is only freed when the relevant spinlock (`lweventlist_lock`) is acquired. This prevents potential race conditions and ensures safe access and modification of shared resources in a concurrent environment, addressing the reported issue of a released reference being accessed. Overall, the patch enhances thread safety in the linkwatch implementation by enforcing proper locking mechanisms whenever the tracker is freed.
